videos.title: What on Earth?
videos.description: Treasure hunters have searched for a lost Incan city of untold wealth for a century, but new technology might finally locate its riches; a strange mountain in Egypt sparks an investigation into Cleopatra's gems and the tomb of Alexander the Great.

videos.title: What on Earth?
videos.description: Researchers investigate a strange glowing lake reported to turn things into stone; a structure in Africa that resembles Stonehenge is said to be the resting place of a mythical giant.

videos.title: What on Earth?
videos.description: A mysterious Stonehenge-like structure in Russia may have links to the Nazis; experts uncover clues to a megatsunami with the power to devastate the United States; a huge lake appears in the Sahara overnight.

videos.title: Forbidden History
videos.description: Mary Magdalene, a key figure in Christianity, traveled with Jesus and is said to have witnessed his crucifixion and resurrection.

videos.title: Forbidden History
videos.description: Templar fact and fiction have become blurred by their depictions in book and on film. This program presents a very different picture that challenges head on the orthodox beliefs about an order that angered much of Europe - particularly France.

videos.title: BattleBots
videos.description: The legends of robot combat put it all on the line for a shot at the 2018 World Championship.

videos.title: BattleBots
videos.description: Fan favorites Yeti and Witch Doctor face off in a world-class fight as top competitors battle to earn their spots in the postseason tournament.

videos.title: BattleBots
videos.description: Legends Hypershock and Bite Force face off in an epic showdown, while up-and-comers try to prove they have what it takes to be crowned 2018 BattleBots World Champion.

videos.title: BattleBots
videos.description: Reigning champion Tombstone takes on the legendary Gigabyte as the battles heat up to take home the renowned BattleBots trophy.

videos.description: In order to build a colossal airplane, the crew needs to gather parts from around the world; three dump trucks need to be shipped.

videos.title: Mega Shippers
videos.description: A nearly 2 billion dollar bridge is being built, and Mega Shippers need to lift portions of the bridge 180 feet above a river; in Florida, $150 million-worth of yachts need to be moved without incident.

videos.title: Mega Shippers
videos.description: In Louisiana, tons of biofuel is destined for a power plant across the Atlantic; a ship loader dangles in the sky; a faulty radio could squash the operation.

videos.title: Mega Shippers
videos.description: Shippers in Virginia have a few hours to move 5,700 tons of cargo onto a barge, but a thunderstorm threatens the chances of completing the task; one of the world's largest cruise ships needs to restock.

videos.title: Mega Shippers
videos.description: $34 million worth of cars must be shipped across the Atlantic; nuclear parts needing to be shipped present a unique set of problems.

videos.title: Unexplained and Unexplored
videos.description: Meriwether Lewis was the man who teamed with William Clark to map the lands west of the Mississippi, but he died in mysterious circumstances; experts reveal a vast conspiracy that could prove that one of America's greatest explorers was murdered.

videos.description: Using a long-lost treasure map purporting to show the whereabouts of a missing ship buried with gold and silver in the California desert, a team of experts uses the new evidence to get closer to a game-changing discovery.
